dimension_flags.meaning: Teaches concepts without automatically assuming a product sale or securities recommendation
A sale, affiliate commission, paid relationship or financial solicitation may be present; verify evidence
Specific securities tips, high-return claims, impersonation or group-chat solicitations need distinct source-based review
Finance content is an overlapping broad topical niche; cross-tags with software/education/business possible

measurement_and_classification_rules: Classify observable content/topic and disclosed business relationships; never infer whether the creator is licensed, truthful, a fraudster or a registered adviser without independent public evidence.
General budgeting education is not by itself a paid product advertisement; sponsoring a finance lesson does not by itself make all lessons investment advice.
Financial-product affiliate partnerships and owned products are separate revenue pathways from YouTube ad sharing, and need distinct revenue and compliance records.
Do not treat a platform paid-promotion toggle as a substitute for local consumer, banking, securities, lending, or advertising requirements.
Do not infer investment adviser registration, local financial regulation or treaty jurisdiction from language, creator ethnicity, channel location or viewer comments.
Do not assume a topic is advertiser-friendly, profitable, or restricted simply because it concerns finance.
All eight categories can overlap and cannot be summed as disjoint populations.
Search/download methods must follow platform permissions and avoid collecting individualized financial details or claims about private people.

regional_status.united_states: Selected primary FTC and SEC federal guidance researched; specific product state laws and registration facts unverified
